lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zài xuéxiào de rìzi.
lines.english: I like the days at school.

lines.hanzi: 早上八点上课，中午在食堂吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshang bā diǎn shàngkè, zhōngwǔ zài shítáng chīfàn.
lines.english: Class at eight in the morning, eat at the cafeteria at noon.

lines.hanzi: 下午有体育课，我们打球，跑步。
lines.pinyin: Xiàwǔ yǒu tǐyù kè, wǒmen dǎ qiú, pǎobù.
lines.english: In the afternoon there's PE class, we play ball, run.

lines.hanzi: 图书馆很安静，我常去那儿看书。
lines.pinyin: Túshūguǎn hěn ānjìng, wǒ cháng qù nàr kàn shū.
lines.english: The library is very quiet, I often go there to read.

lines.hanzi: 老师很认真，讲课很清楚。
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn rènzhēn, jiǎngkè hěn qīngchu.
lines.english: Teachers are very serious, lectures are very clear.

lines.hanzi: 同学们很友好，我们一起学习，一起玩。
lines.pinyin: Tóngxuémen hěn yǒuhǎo, wǒmen yīqǐ xuéxí, yīqǐ wán.
lines.english: Classmates are very friendly, we study together, play together.

lines.hanzi: 考试以前大家都很努力复习。
lines.pinyin: Kǎoshì yǐqián dàjiā dōu hěn nǔlì fùxí.
lines.english: Before exams everyone reviews very hard.

lines.hanzi: 学校生活丰富，我学到很多知识。
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào shēnghuó fēngfù, wǒ xuédào hěn duō zhīshi.
lines.english: School life is rich, I learn a lot of knowledge.

lines.hanzi: 我希望以后还能回学校看看。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng yǐhòu hái néng huí xuéxiào kànkan.
lines.english: I hope in the future I can still go back to visit the school.
